item: Whether a currency gain is a 'personal transaction'
why: § 988(e)(1) applies the section only to transactions that are not an individual's personal transaction, and § 988(e)(3) makes a transaction non-personal to the extent its expenses fall under §162 or §212. The character of the gain therefore depends on that classification: ordinary income if the money is investment or business money, and for personal money no gain recognised up to $200 with a larger gain reported as a capital gain (IRS Pub. 525). Which side a savings balance falls on is a legal judgement this site does not make.
what_would_settle_it: A U.S. tax professional, with the dates and rates at which the RMB was acquired.
